newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks rebound on Q1 public finances, Dow.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks rebound on Q1 public finances, Dow.

text.p: Mexican stocks returned to positive territory at midday dealing on Thursday after bottom fishing buyers stepped in to the market, encouraged by the announcement of favorable public sector finances coupled with a recovery on Wall Street, traders said.
"I like the market because it is consdolidating. Prices were very good and economic indicators were very positive,' a floor trader said.
The leading IPC share index .MXX was up 7.26 points, or 0.19 percent, at 3,901.46.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was meanwhile up 14.01 points at 7,300.17 points.

Finance Minister Guillermo Ortiz announced Mexico's public finances for the first quarter. Among other data, Ortiz said Mexico posted a public sector surplus of 8.991 billion pesos in the first quarter.
